import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis in Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top 15 Dog Breeds
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(15)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
top_breeds.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax1, color='steelblue')
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Breed', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Top 15 Most Popular Dog Breeds', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(top_breeds.values):
    ax1.text(v + 50, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog Gender Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
gender_counts = df['SexHundLang'].value_counts()
colors_gender = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(gender_counts.values, labels=gender_counts.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors_gender)
ax2.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontsize(11)
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 3. Dogs by District (Kreis)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
district_counts.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax3, color='coral')
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('District (Kreis)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Dog Distribution by District', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(district_counts.values):
    ax3.text(v + 50, i, str(int(v)), va='center', fontsize=9)

# 4. Dog Age Distribution
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
age_data = df[df['AlterVHundNum'].notna() & (df['AlterVHundNum'] <= 20)]
ax4.hist(age_data['AlterVHundNum'], bins=20, color='mediumseagreen', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Dog Age (Years)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Dog Age Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax4.axvline(age_data['AlterVHundNum'].median(), color='red', linestyle='--', 
            linewidth=2, label=f'Median: {age_data["AlterVHundNum"].median():.1f} years')
ax4.legend(fontsize=10)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
